verdict.rationale: Replicate is a model inference platform, so prompt/prefix caching is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never mentions caching of repeated context. Batching, autoscaling and per-second billing are related speed and cost features, not prompt or prefix caching, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can benefit from prompt/prefix caching that reduces latency or cost on repeated context
